answer: Each challenge is cryptographically bound to a future threshold-BLS beacon pulse: its seed is revealed only after an irrevocable submission window, making answers impossible to precompute and identities unable to choose favorable timing. Since the jointly generated pulse is publicly verifiable and bias-resistant, offline farming yields no reusable advantage; every vertex, fable, or basalt task requires a fresh, unpredictable response, denying Sybil swarms scalable leverage.
